summary: MSc Data Science student at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg with deep learning and computer vision work that has been through peer review. Co-author of PrisonSecure (ICISD 2025, Atlantis Press / Springer Nature), a deep-learning surveillance system on live CCTV feeds: weapon detection with YOLOv11 at 95.79% mAP@0.5, precision and recall both at 0.93, and face recognition at 93.75% accuracy. Trained a convolutional neural network in PyTorch end to end for American Sign Language image recognition, and delivered 10+ production-ready models in Python during an AI & ML internship where I was recognised as Best Performer. Python and Git across every role, plus cloud operations experience from VMware infrastructure.

bullets: Recognised as Best Performer of the cohort across 8 end-to-end machine learning projects, delivering 10+ production-ready models in Python.
Ran an automated hyperparameter search with GridSearchCV on a Support Vector Machine, achieving 95%+ ROC-AUC, and applied the elbow method to select k for K-Nearest-Neighbours classification.
Built a Walmart weekly-sales forecasting model with XGBoost reaching 96.1% R² and reducing forecast error by 18%.

Delivered classification, regression and clustering models across medical and commercial datasets: breast-cancer diagnosis at 96%+ accuracy, housing-price prediction above 0.90 R², heart-disease prediction with Decision Trees and Random Forests, and 200 customers segmented into 5 clusters at a silhouette score of 0.55.
Built an ATS Resume Checker powered by large language models, parsing resumes, scoring them against job descriptions and returning structured feedback.

Designed and iterated LLM prompts and embedding-based retrieval on Google Vertex AI, deployed the application against managed endpoints, and set up evaluation loops to measure and improve output quality.
Operated and supported VMware virtualisation infrastructure, automated infrastructure tasks and set up monitoring for cloud workloads.
Applied and enforced security guidelines across managed environments.
Built an American Sign Language image-recognition system with a Convolutional Neural Network in PyTorch.
Implemented the full training, validation and inference pipeline, including data augmentation to improve generalisation.

publications.title: PrisonSecure: A Smart Surveillance System for Prisons using Deep Learning
publications.authors: B. Athul Krishna, R. P. Aakash, Joshua Jose, S. Anubha Pearline
publications.venue: Proceedings of the International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Digital Transformation (ICISD 2025), Atlantis Highlights in Intelligent Systems, Atlantis Press (Springer Nature), pp. 1015-1033
publications.description: Final-year thesis project: a deep-learning surveillance system for prison environments running on live CCTV feeds. Weapon detection with YOLOv11 and hard negative mining to suppress false positives from visually similar objects; face recognition through a ResNet-based detector, FaceNet embeddings and an SVM classifier; real-time audio alerting on detection. Reported results: 95.79% mAP@0.5 with precision and recall both at 0.93, and 93.75% accuracy for face recognition.
